column1: # unarmed.tsv -- THE FLOOR: every built mechanism known to be off. #754.
# A RATCHET, NOT A TO-DO LIST. bin/unarmed.sh is silent while this set merely
# persists and red the moment it GROWS -- a probe_* predicate with no row here
# is a mechanism someone shipped and deferred the arming of. Zach, 2026-08-30:
# a row red for 19 days is wallpaper, and wallpaper on a panel teaches its
# reader to skip the panel.
# Each UNARMED row declares its own window in `DEFAULT-AFTER <n>d` shape
# (bin/lib/body-grammar.sh) and goes red only past it. A row with no window
# blocks by omission, so an empty window is itself a finding.
# `since` is the date THIS ROW WAS FILED -- when the floor started watching
# it -- never the date the underlying mechanism was built or the gap noticed.
# #837: four rows were dated earlier than that, which spent 13-19 days of a
# 7-30d silence budget before the row could be read by anyone, and one
# (host-mode) came within 9 days of EXPIRING on the day it was first
# surfaced. `since` only ever answers "how long has the floor been silent
# about this" -- a build date, if worth keeping, belongs in the issue this
# row cites, not here.
# TRAP: ids are hyphen-only. The growth check maps probe_host_mode back to
# host-mode by `_` -> `-`, so an underscore in an id makes its own row
# unreachable and the mechanism reads as newly grown.
# id
